thread:
olivia: Quick proposal — onboarding plan for mix-and-match quant variants (FP8 / GPTQ / AWQ). We need a single rollout that spans hosted + dedicated, with private strictly opt-in. Draft below, feedback pls.

sahil: SGTM on opt-in private. Can't auto-route private without legal sign-off.

kevin: Need hard numbers for the gates. What thresholds trigger automatic rollback vs alert only?

olivia: Proposed numeric gates:
- Golden-set regression: >0.5% absolute F1 drop -> AUTOMATIC rollback
- End-to-end quality delta (user-anchor evals): >1.0% -> pause progression, manual review
- Latency p95: >20% over baseline -> throttle traffic + alert
- Token cost delta: >15% increase -> alert and don't progress to next step

Here's a rollout snippet to discuss (dry-run JSON):
```json
{
  "variant": "fp8-a",
  "environments": {
    "hosted": {"steps": ["1%:30m","5%:30m","20%:1h"]},
    "dedicated": {"steps": ["0.5%:30m","5%:1h"]},
    "private": {"steps": [], "auto": false}
  },
  "gates": {"golden_f1_abs": 0.5, "p95_latency_pct": 20, "cost_pct": 15},
  "probe_sampling": 0.1,
  "rollback_on_fail": true
}
```

maria: Ran a quick micro-bench on the new fp8-a / awq-int8 / gptq-v2 across our eval shard (small sample). Short summary:
```
- fp8-a: +0.4% MMLU, p95 +8% latency, golden_f1 delta -0.2
- awq-int8: -1.1% summarization F1, p95 +5% latency, golden_f1 delta -1.1
- gptq-v2: -0.6% MMLU, p95 +3% latency, golden_f1 delta -0.5
```
Artifacts uploaded: link -> https://artifacts/reports/2182345678_fp8-microbench

bench-bot: perf-smoke: AWQ-int8 shows 1.1% degradation on summarization set; fp8-a is within noise for QA but watch tail latency. Full CSV attached. :eyes:

aj: Operationally we should treat this as a cross-env "traffic corridor": hosted ramps 1 -> 5 -> 20%, dedicated 0.5 -> 5%, private only manual opt-in. Each step 30m min, require no gate failures to progress. Also: make 10% of canary requests probe requests that hit golden-eval pipeline to get near-real-time quality signals.

deploy-bot: Started dry-run canary for variant=fp8-a on hosted (dry-run mode). No traffic diverted, collecting metrics.

sahil: I'll kick off a replay on staging to validate KV-cache and batching effects — caching can mask regressions. ETA 2h.

kevin: Who owns the fallback set? Need an explicit ordered fallback list (model ids) to plug into rollout policy. Also need a documented degrade policy for multi-tenant fallbacks.

olivia: Fallbacks we should pre-register: ["gptq-v2", "awq-int8-safe", "fp16-base"]. I'll add them to the infra runbook and the rollout JSON as an ordered list.

maria: I'll push the golden-set + seed prompts to the eval service (versioned). Will tag with run id 2182345678.golden so canary queries hit the right baseline.

aj: Small note: make sure dedicated autoscaling doesn't add capacity mid-canary — that can hide perf problems. Add a flag to pin instance types for canary windows.

kevin: Add explicit metric hooks: golden_f1, user_anchor_delta, p95_latency, tokens_per_request, error_rate. All must be collected per-env and per-variant.

olivia: Agreed. Also adding a short circuitleg rule: if error_rate > 0.5% absolute, immediate rollback.

maria: Command I'll use to start the actual dry-run when we're ready:
```bash
rcli rollout start --variant fp8-a --env hosted --dry-run --probe 10% --notes "mixmatch onboarding"
```

deploy-bot: Dry-run logs available at https://deploys.company/dryruns/2182345678. Will post updates as metrics arrive.

aj: Action items: olivia add rollout JSON + fallback list to infra repo; sahil run staging replay and post cache-aware metrics; maria push golden-set and run eval; kevin add metric hooks to console dashboards. Target: real canary start tomorrow 14:00 PST if dry-run looks clean.

kevin: I'll take dashboard ownership for the canary window.

olivia: Perfect — thanks all. If dry-run shows >0.5% golden_f1 drop anywhere, we do not promote. Marking this thread high priority. :thumbsup:

maria: ack, starting uploads now.
